name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a development-stage silver-gold company focused on advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The Diablillos Project is a large-scale silver-gold resource that received provincial environmental approval in 2026 and was approved under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI). The company also holds exploration-stage properties including La Coipita and Aguas Perdidas.
